messages:
maria: quick design poke put a tiny prototype in figma + staging. two tradeoffs: primary streaming control should be 'Pause' (resumable) or 'Stop' (finalize). also: token counter placement - inline under streaming message vs top-right header. link: https://figma.com/proto/stream-ui :eyes: devin: Inline control makes more sense visually. If we make 'Pause' primary we need clear microcopy about what Pause does (does it buffer? cancel?). Also add aria attributes for state. sam: Inline counter under the message wins. Header is detached from context. Suggest collapsing exact numbers by default (show "~42" or hide until hover) for privacy. For copy: 'Pause generation' vs just 'Pause' feels clearer. elaine: a11y items: use aria-live on the stream container and `aria-busy` while streaming. When you change state (pausing/resuming/stopped) ensure an offscreen status node announces it. Also keyboard reachable controls (tab order). ravi: I'm worried about the UX when users think Pause = save state. We should show a toast/inline annotation: "Paused Resume to continue generation". Regenerate should not spawn a new message thread; prefer overlay state with spinner and text "Regenerating". Also beware of accidental double-clicks when toggling actions. maria: good call. Proposal: primary = Pause (inline), secondary = Stop in overflow menu for "hard cancel". Token counter inline, collapsed to an estimate; full number on hover or accessible via a focusable control. We'll A/B test copy. devin: sample aria snippet for prototype: ```html
``` Make sure screen readers get "Generation paused" announcements. sam: tooltip copy: "Estimated tokens used (prompt + output)". Button tooltip: "Pause generation (Esc)". That gives keyboard hinting. elaine: keyboard mapping: Esc toggles pause when focus in chat. When paused, focus should move to the message-level actions so a keyboard user can press Resume. `/` to jump to prompt composer. Ensure focus styles meet contrast. ux-bot: accessibility quick-check: aria-live? yes. aria-busy? yes. keyboard shortcuts documented? pending. focus management? pending. tooltips accessible? yes if tied to aria-describedby. deploy-bot: Staging build available: https://playground.staging.redwood/preview/stream-ui-182 (expires in 72h) maria: action items: @devin wire aria-live/aria-busy and paused state announcements in prototype; @sam implement inline counter collapsed with hover expansion and update tooltip; @elaine add keyboard mappings + focus rules to the a11y doc; @ravi write the small copy for paused banner. I'll upload Figma variants (Pause-primary / Stop-primary + inline counter collapsed/expanded) by EOD and run a quick internal test with 6 folks. :thumbsup:
